question: ______ is a kharif crop in north and rabi crop in south India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sesamum.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sesamum is a kharif crop in north India as it requires a hot and humid climate, while in south India, it is grown as a rabi crop as the weather conditions are suitable for its growth during winters.**
 
• ** Mustard is a rabi crop** mainly grown in northern and central parts of India during winter.
 
• **Castor is a kharif crop** mainly grown in the states of Gujarat, Andhra Pradesh, and Rajasthan during the monsoon season.
 
• ** Linseed is also a rabi crop **mainly grown in the northern and central parts of India during the winter season.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• ** Sesamum, also known as sesame or til is widely used in Indian cuisine for its nutty flavor and high nutritional value. It is also used for making oil, sweets, and other food products.**
 
• Mustard is a rich omega-3 fatty acids, protein, and dietary fiber source. It is used for making mustard oil, pickles, and condiments.
 
• Castor is a medicinal plant; its oil is used for various purposes, such as treating skin problems, constipation, and arthritis. It is also used to manufacture soaps, lubricants, and plastics.
 
• Linseed is also known as flaxseed and is a rich source of omega-3 fatty acids, lignans, and dietary fiber. It is used for making oil, bread, and other food products. It is also used to manufacture textiles, paper, and paint.
